responsibility: Implements the Thumb-1-specific machine-description patterns for the Arm backend. It defines Thumb-1 RTL insns, splits, peepholes, calls, branches, prologue/epilogue helpers, tablejump lowering, stack-protector test sequences, and many arithmetic and control-flow forms whose encodings or flag behavior differ from ARM or Thumb-2, providing the main instruction-selection layer for classic 16-bit Thumb targets.
